title: Pager exclusive WAL connection opening

scope.rationale: pagerExclusiveLock and pagerOpenWal form the dependency-closed connection-opening boundary for exclusive-locking WAL mode. The Pager now restores SHARED after a failed exclusive acquisition, acquires EXCLUSIVE before opening the WAL, and selects a connection-private in-memory index that avoids VFS shared-memory methods.
excluded_responsibilities: Public sqlite3PagerOpenWal mode transition and rollback-journal close
Mapped-page limit recalculation because the native Pager does not expose mapped database pages
WAL discovery and malformed WAL recovery policy

external_source_responsibilities: Wal.open owns WAL-file allocation, recovery, read-lock state, and cleanup
Pager caller owns SHARED or EXCLUSIVE database-file lock
sqlite3PagerOpenWal caller publishes WAL journal mode
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete source bodies are assigned. beginRead requested-WAL and existing-WAL discovery paths invoke the same connection owner, and the private-index Wal transport now avoids shared-memory map, lock, barrier, and publication calls.

inputs: Mutable non-memory Pager with no WAL owner and SHARED or EXCLUSIVE database lock
Boolean identifying whether the WAL file already exists
outputs: Exact lock, VFS, allocation, recovery, or success ResultCode and a Pager-owned Wal only on success
contracts.ownership: Wal.open transfers a complete Wal value to Pager only after successful initialization. Failure cleanup remains inside Wal.open; database-file and VFS owners remain borrowed.
contracts.state_and_results: Exclusive locking saves the original lock, attempts EXCLUSIVE, and restores the original SHARED lock after failure. Successful exclusive mode opens with a private index; ordinary mode retains shared-memory index transport.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Database xLock/xUnlock precede exclusive WAL opening. Private-index Wal operations skip xShmMap/xShmLock/xShmBarrier while retaining WAL-file I/O; ordinary mode keeps native shared-memory calls.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Failed EXCLUSIVE leaves the original SHARED lock. Failed WAL open publishes no owner. beginRead cleanup deinitializes any completed owner and returns Pager to open state.

representation_differences: Pager.exclusive_locking replaces source exclusiveMode and is selected at native Pager construction.
Wal.publish_native_index false retains recovered frame/index metadata in Wal-owned Zig maps and makes shared-memory transport a no-op instead of passing an exclusiveMode flag through sqlite3WalOpen.
pagerFixMaplimit has no production counterpart because this Pager does not expose database mmap pages; WAL file transport and Pager cache limits remain independent.

The retired no-credit internal pager_core exclusiveLockRecovering claim remains historical evidence only; the new production Pager declaration has a distinct declaration identity and hash and owns the post-retirement integrated path.

oracle.protocol: Open a writable Pager in exclusive-locking mode, request WAL during beginRead, require EXCLUSIVE database lock, require a live Wal using the private index, and close the read transaction safely. Existing WAL and Pager differential suites retain ordinary shared-memory transport coverage.
internal_observations: Pager lock level before and after open
oracle.normalization: Compare exact ResultCode, lock level, owner presence, and private-index boolean.

assurance.oom: Wal allocation/open failure returns no_memory and publishes no Pager owner.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: EXCLUSIVE database lock is acquired before private-index WAL file access. Ordinary WAL mode keeps VFS shared-memory locking.
assurance.malformed_input: Existing malformed WAL recovery errors before owner publication; typed state assertions constrain lock and owner inputs.
assurance.continuation: Failed lock restores SHARED; failed beginRead returns open; successful read can end and close safely.
assurance.performance: Constant lock setup plus WAL open/recovery; private mode eliminates shared-memory calls while EXCLUSIVE serializes connections.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig native Pager and src/core/wal.zig private index transport
integration.native_call_path: Pager.beginRead invokes openWalConnection for requested WAL; openWalIfPresent invokes it for an existing WAL. Exclusive mode acquires EXCLUSIVE and Wal.open bypasses shared-memory transport.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Duplicated beginRead/openWalIfPresent Wal.open calls and the nonfunctional external-index shared-map branch are retired.
